```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"

```

We are investigating occurrence data of [**Glowworms**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glowworm) in Australia from the **Atlas of Living Australia**, and make a map showing the spatial locations of sightings from 2014 to 2024.

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load required packages
library(galah)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(geosphere)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Set up ALA Access
galah_config(email = "vahdatjavad@gmail.com")

# Define and perform the search
glowworm_taxon <- search_taxa("Arachnocampa")
occ_data <- galah_call() |> 
  galah_identify(glowworm_taxon) |>  
  galah_filter(year >= 2014, year <= 2024) |>
  galah_select(decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, year, eventDate, scientificName) |>
  atlas_occurrences()

# Drop records with missing coordinates
glowworms <- occ_data |> 
  filter(!is.na(decimalLatitude), !is.na(decimalLongitude), !is.na(eventDate)) |>
  mutate(
    obs_lat = decimalLatitude,
    obs_lon = decimalLongitude,
    eventDate = ymd_hms(eventDate),
    datetime = eventDate,
    month = month(eventDate),
    day = day(eventDate),
    weekday = wday(eventDate, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    dayofyear = yday(eventDate),
    scientificName = str_remove(scientificName, "\\s*\\([^\\)]+\\)")
  ) %>%
  select(obs_lat, obs_lon, year, month, day, weekday, dayofyear, datetime, scientificName)

# Save data
usethis::use_data(glowworms, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
load("../data/glowworms.rda")
head(glowworms)
```

the **length** of the records is `r nrow(glowworms)`

#### Weekly Distribution of organism 

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
week_order <- c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday")
glowworms |> drop_na(weekday) |> 
ggplot(aes(x = factor(weekday, levels = week_order))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Week Days Distribution of Glowworm Occurrences",
    x = "Week day", y = "Number of Records"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

#### Monthly Distribution of organism 

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
glowworms |> drop_na(month) |>
  mutate(month = month(month, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) |> 
ggplot(aes(x = factor(month, levels = month.name))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Distribution of Glowworm Occurrences",
    x = "Month", y = "Number of Records"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

#### Nearest Weather Station Mapping

```{r, echo=FALSE}
load("../data/glowworms.rda")
load("../data/weather_stations.rda")
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}

nearest_station_ids <- sapply(1:nrow(glowworms), function(i) {
  dists <- distHaversine(
    cbind(weather_stations$stn_lon, weather_stations$stn_lat),
    c(glowworms$obs_lon[i], glowworms$obs_lat[i])
  )
  weather_stations$stnid[which.min(dists)]
})

glowworms$weather_station_id <- nearest_station_ids
glowworms_ws <- glowworms %>%
  left_join(weather_stations, by = c("weather_station_id" = "stnid"))

usethis::use_data(glowworms_ws)
```

```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
load("../data/glowworms_ws.rda")
head(glowworms_ws, n = 3)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
load("../data/glowworms_ws.rda")
state_freq <- table(glowworms_ws$state)
state_freq <- sort(state_freq, decreasing = TRUE)
state_freq_df <- as.data.frame(state_freq)
colnames(state_freq_df) <- c("State", "Frequency")
state_freq_df
```

#### Pattern Analysis

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
glowworms_ws$month <- format(glowworms_ws$datetime, "%B")
glowworms_ws$month_num <- as.numeric(format(glowworms_ws$datetime, "%m"))

ggplot(glowworms_ws, aes(x = factor(month, levels = month.name))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Distribution of Glowworm Occurrences by State",
    x = "Month", y = "Number of Records"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ state, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)))
```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
glowworms_ws$date <- as.Date(glowworms_ws$datetime)
glowworms_ws <- glowworms_ws %>%
  mutate(week = week(date),
         week_start = floor_date(date, "week"))

weekly_counts <- glowworms_ws %>%
  count(week_start, state)

ggplot(weekly_counts, aes(x = week_start, y = n, group = state)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2ca02c") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#d62728") +
  facet_wrap(~state, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly Occurrence Patterns of Glowworms with Trend Lines",
    x = "Week Starting", y = "Observations"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
glowworms_ws <- glowworms_ws %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    month = format(date, "%B"),
    month_num = as.numeric(format(date, "%m"))
  )

state_monthly <- glowworms_ws %>%
  group_by(state, month) %>%
  summarize(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * count / sum(count))

ggplot(state_monthly, aes(x = month, y = percent, color = state, group = state)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  coord_polar() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = month.name) +
  labs(title = "Seasonal Patterns of Glowworm Occurrences by State",
       x = NULL, y = "Percentage of Occurrences") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Clean and prepare data
df <- glowworms_ws %>%
  filter(!is.na(obs_lat), !is.na(obs_lon), !is.na(month)) %>%
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = month.name))  # Ensure proper month order

# Load Australia base map (sf object)
aus_map <- ne_states(country = "Australia", returnclass = "sf")

# Create faceted map by month
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = aus_map, fill = "gray95", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(data = df, aes(x = obs_lon, y = obs_lat, color = state), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = df, aes(x = stn_lon, y = stn_lat), shape = 2, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5)+
  coord_sf(xlim = c(110, 155), ylim = c(-45, -10)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Glowworm Occurrences Sightings in Australia",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "State"
  )


```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
 geom_point(data = df, aes(x = obs_lon, y = obs_lat, color = state), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
```

### Datasets Overview

We have organized the glowworm occurrence and weather station data into the following structured datasets, stored in the `data/` directory:

-   `glowworms_2024.rda`  
    Contains glowworm occurrence records across all states in Australia.

-   `glowworms_2024_ws.rda`  
    An enhanced version of the occurrence data, merged with the nearest weather station information, including:

    ```
    --Station ID (weather_station_id)
    --Station name (stname)
    --Geographic details (lat.y, lon.y, address, city, state)
    ```

-   `glowworms_top_weather.rda`  
    Focuses on weather data from the top 3 most frequently recorded stations associated with glowworm occurrences.

-   `weather_stations.rda`  
    A standalone dataset of all unique weather stations in Australia, providing reference metadata for cross-referencing.
